Fires on the predicate complement word right after a copula ("she's ___", "you won't be ___", "to be ___ on"), typically a progressive/participial or state verb (waiting, soaking, invested, bent on); it is strongly *suppressed* on trait-describing adjectives/nouns in the same slot (social, worker, gullible, law-abiding).
